title: Viewport & Interaction Regression Sweep — prioritized bug backlog for Safari/Firefox/mobile
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Run a focused regression sweep across viewport sizes and browser engines to triage and prioritize visual/interaction inconsistencies in the UI kit (tokens, buttons, table layouts, and chart scaling). Goal: create a prioritized bug backlog with reproduction steps, severity, and recommended design/engineering touches so engineering can batch fixes into the next runtime sprint. This ticket covers investigations, decisions about token consolidation or CSS approaches, and creation of follow-up design tasks/PR guidance.
steps_to_reproduce: Open Redwood UI kit demo pages (Buttons / Tables / Charts) on macOS Safari 17.1, Firefox 116, iOS Safari (16/17), and Android Chrome (for mobile reference).
Resize viewport to common breakpoints (320px, 375px, 412px, 540px, 768px, 1024px) and observe wrapping, truncation, and touch target sizes.
Interact with components: focus states, keyboard navigation, sticky table headers, column overflow behavior, chart tooltips and pan/zoom gestures on mobile.
Record visual diffs (screenshot + viewport metadata) and note token mismatches (spacing, type scale, radii), and any JS/CSS errors in console.
bug_summary: BTN-01: Primary button vertical alignment off in Safari iOS at 375px (padding computed differently vs Chrome). Severity: high (affects CTAs).
TAB-07: Table sticky header jitter when resizing in Firefox — header repaint causes misaligned column borders. Severity: medium (visual disruption).
CHT-03: SVG charts overflow container on Android widths < 360px; tooltip positioning uses absolute px values. Severity: medium-high (breaks mobile charts).
TOK-12: Redundant spacing tokens causing inconsistent 8/12px gaps between icon+label across breakpoints. Severity: low but wide impact across kit.
ACC-04: Focus outline is not visible in high-contrast mode on Safari when using our reduced-outline mixin. Severity: high (accessibility).
comments: 2025-02-12 — Sofia Martinez: Initial sweep run on macOS Safari 17.1 and iOS 17. Found several high-impact items on Buttons and Charts. Saving screenshots to Drive and creating this ticket to coordinate fixes with ENG.

2025-02-13 — Emily Chen: Reproduced BTN-01 locally. Suspect padding computed from a combination of -webkit-appearance and our reset. Proposed: scope a Safari-specific reset or switch to system-agnostic min-height + line-height tokens. Filing a mini-PR guidance note.

2025-02-14 — Lucas Nguyen (Frontend): TAB-07 looks like a Firefox repaint bug triggered by transform on the table container. Quick win: avoid transform on ancestor when sticky header is used; longer term: test CSS contain:isolation. Adding ENG-3421 as dependency for runtime layout change.

2025-02-15 — Mia Johnson (UX Research): Mobile chart overflow reproduced on Pixel 6 / Android 13. Tooltips anchored with pixel offsets—recommend switching to inset-based anchoring or relative transform for responsiveness. Adding chart scaling test cases to the visual regression suite.

2025-02-18 — Raj Patel (PM): Prioritizing fixes: BTN-01 and ACC-04 -> P0 for next patch; CHT-03 and TAB-07 -> P1 for next sprint. TOK-12 to be scheduled as part of token consolidation epic. Confirmed release target: design-system-3.8 patch release window 2025-03.
2025-02-20 — Emily Chen: Drafted CSS change set and shared prototype in Figma. Refer to PR guidance and ENG-PR references below. Moving ticket to In Progress for design review + pairing with ENG.
acceptance_criteria: Buttons: Primary and secondary button render identical visual height, vertical alignment, and touch target across tested Safari/Firefox/Chrome viewports (320–1024px).
Tables: Sticky headers do not jitter in Firefox; header borders align with columns after resize. Visual diffs should be green in Percy for the affected stories.
Charts: SVG scaling uses relative anchoring; tooltips no longer overflow and reposition correctly on mobile. No layout shift larger than 5px when toggling series.
Tokens: Identify at most 6 spacing/type tokens for consolidation and publish a token-change RFC before implementation.
Accessibility: Focus outline visible in Safari high-contrast; keyboard navigation order preserved for buttons and table rows.
decisions: Use CSS logical properties and token-driven min-height/line-height for button vertical rhythm rather than browser resets when possible.
For Firefox sticky header jitter, prefer avoiding transform/filters on parent containers; ENG to evaluate layout containment solutions for performance-sensitive pages.
Charts move to relative tooltip anchoring with transform: translate() for subpixel stability across mobile browsers.
Token consolidation scoped to a small bump release (design-system-3.8) with migration notes and a feature flag where needed to avoid breaking dedicated deployments.
